verdict.rationale: Paddle ships genuine machine/agent-facing API exploration: an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and Postman collection for interactive exploration (paddle-docs-24, paddle-docs-25), a docs MCP server letting agents search the OpenAPI spec and SDK references (paddle-supp-docs-mcp), and a live Paddle MCP server with a codemode interface whose search and execute tools let an agent look up methods and actually run chained API calls against a sandbox environment (paddle-supp-mcp-codemode, paddle-supp-sandbox), independently confirmed live via probe (paddle-probe-4). Missing for 10: a dedicated human-facing interactive API reference page (e.g. Swagger-UI style try-it-out) is not evidenced; execution is via MCP/codemode rather than a browsable docs UI.
